test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the highlighted idiom.

As the Director I had to **bite the bullet** in order to restore normalcy.

options.text: To force people to do the right thing
Force oneself to do something unpleasant

solution:
The correct answer is Force oneself to do something unpleasant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the idiom 'bite the bullet' is 'Force oneself to do something unpleasant'.
 
• bite the bullet: decide **to do something difficult** or unpleasant that one has been putting off or hesitating over
 
 
• *Example: Decisions have to be taken and as director you have got to bite the bullet.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above the correct answer is option 3.

Correct meaning:__ *Force oneself to do something unpleasant*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
